zh.title: 英國航空擬每架A380移除88經濟艙座位
zh.summary: 英國航空擬改裝A380機隊；每架移除88經濟艙座位
body: 據Simple Flying報導，英國航空（British Airways）正準備將其空中巴士A380機隊改造為更現代化的高級座椅配置，並計劃繼續營運這款超級珍寶客機（Superjumbo）。
報導指出，英國航空將從其機隊中的每架空中巴士A380上移除88個經濟艙座位。這項改裝計畫反映了該公司對未來使用A380機隊的規劃。
報導來源為Simple Flying於2026年10月4日發布的報導，標題為「Why British Airways Is Stripping 88 Economy Seats From Every Airbus A380 In Its Fleet」.

en.title: British Airways Plans to Remove 88 Economy Seats From Each Airbus A380
en.summary: BA plans A380 retrofit; remove 88 economy seats per aircraft
body: According to Simple Flying, British Airways is preparing to retrofit its Airbus A380 fleet into a more modern premium seating configuration and plans to continue operating the Superjumbo aircraft.
The report states that British Airways will remove 88 economy seats from every Airbus A380 in its fleet.
The report was published by Simple Flying on October 4, 2026, with the title "Why British Airways Is Stripping 88 Economy Seats From Every Airbus A380 In Its Fleet".
